entries.만 15세 이상 및 성인은 1회 2캡슐, 1일 3회 식후 30분에 복용합: Those aged 15 years and over and adults take 2 capsules at a time, three times a day, 30 minutes after meals.
entries.만 15세 이상 및 성인은 1회 2캡슐씩, 만 7세 초과~만 15세 미만: Those aged 15 years and over and adults take 2 capsules at a time, and those over 7 years but under 15 years take 1 capsule at a time, three times a day, 30 minutes after meals.
entries.만 15세 이상 성인은 1회 1포, 만 11세 이상~만 15세 미만은 2: Adults aged 15 years and over take 1 sachet at a time, those aged 11 years and over but under 15 years take 2/3 of a sachet, those aged 7 years and over but under 11 years take 1/2 of a sachet, those aged 3 years and over but under 7 years take 1/3 of a sachet, and those aged 2 years and over but under 3 years take 1/4 of a sachet, three times a day, 30 minutes after meals.
entries.만 15세 이상은 1회 1/2포 (15 ml)씩, 만 11세 이상~만 1: Those aged 15 years and over take 1/2 sachet (15 ml) at a time, those aged 11 years and over but under 15 years take 1 sachet (10 ml) at a time, those aged 7 years and over but under 11 years take 3/4 sachet (7.5 ml) at a time, and those aged 3 years and over but under 7 years take 1/2 sachet (5 ml) at a time; for the prevention of motion sickness, take it 30 minutes before boarding a vehicle or vessel. If an additional dose is needed, take one dose leaving an interval of at least 4 hours. Limit the number of doses to 3 times a day.
entries.만 15세 이상은 1회 1포 (15 ml)씩을, 만 11세 이상~만 15: Those aged 15 years and over take 1 sachet (15 ml) at a time, those aged 11 years and over but under 15 years take 2/3 sachet (10 ml) at a time, those aged 8 years and over but under 11 years take 1/2 sachet (7.5 ml) at a time, those aged 5 years and over but under 8 years take 1/3 sachet (5 ml) at a time, those aged 3 years and over but under 5 years take 1/4 sachet (3.75 ml) at a time, and those aged 2 years and over but under 3 years take 1/5 sachet (3 ml) at a time, three times a day, 30 minutes after meals.
entries.만 15세 이상은 1회 1포(20 mL)씩, 만 11세 이상~만 15세: Those aged 15 years and over take 1 sachet (20 mL) at a time, those aged 11 years and over but under 15 years take ⅔ of a sachet at a time, those aged 7 years and over but under 11 years take ½ of a sachet at a time, those aged 3 years and over but under 7 years take ⅓ of a sachet at a time, and those aged 2 years and over but under 3 years take ¼ of a sachet at a time, three times a day, 30 minutes after meals, leaving an interval of 4 hours.
entries.만 15세 이상은 1회 24 mL(2포), 만 11세 이상~만 15세 미: Those aged 15 years and over take 24 mL (2 sachets) at a time, those aged 11 years and over but under 15 years take 16 mL (1 and 1/3 sachets) at a time, those aged 7 years and over but under 11 years take 12 mL (1 sachet) at a time, those aged 3 years and over but under 7 years take 8 mL (2/3 sachet) at a time, and those aged 2 years and over but under 3 years take 6 mL (1/2 sachet) at a time, three times a day, 30 minutes after meals. If necessary it may be taken at bedtime, and as a rule the interval between doses should be 4 hours.
entries.만 15세 이상은 1회 2포(18 mL), 만 11세 이상～만 15세 미: Those aged 15 years and over take 2 sachets (18 mL) at a time, those aged 11 years and over but under 15 years take 11/3 sachets (12 mL) at a time, those aged 7 years and over but under 11 years take 1 sachet (9 mL) at a time, and those aged 3 years and over but under 7 years take 2/3 sachet (6 mL) at a time; the number of doses is limited to 3 times a day. For the prevention of motion sickness, take it 30 minutes before boarding. If an additional dose is needed, take one dose leaving an interval of at least 4 hours.
entries.만 15세 이상은 1회 용량(15 mL)을 1일 4회 식후 30분 및 취: Those aged 15 years and over take one dose (15 mL) four times a day, 30 minutes after meals and at bedtime. However, when taking it 5 to 6 times a day, as a rule leave an interval of about 4 hours between doses.
entries.만 24개월 이상~만 8세 미만은 1일 1회, 1회 1정, 만 8세 이상: Children aged 24 months and over but under 8 years take 1 tablet at a time, once a day, and those aged 8 years and over and adults take 1 tablet at a time, twice a day, letting it dissolve or chewing it.
entries.만 2세 이하의 젖먹이, 눈 또는 눈 주위, 점막(입안, 코안, 질),: Do not use this medicine on nursing infants aged 2 years or under, or on the eyes or the area around the eyes, mucous membranes (inside the mouth, inside the nose, the vagina), the genitals or the external genitalia, or on diseased areas with eczema, dampness, severe erosion, cracking or wounds. Before using this medicine, people with an allergic constitution, those who have experienced allergic symptoms (rash and congested reddened skin, itching, dermatitis caused by lacquer, etc.), patients whose diseased area is on the face or is extensive or festering, and young children should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Use this medicine externally only; do not take it internally or inhale it. Take care that it does not get into the eyes, and if it does, rinse it out immediately with water. Clean the diseased area and the area around it before use. Shake well before use. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. When giving it to a child, administer it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian.
entries.만 3개월 미만의 젖먹이는 이 약을 복용하지 마십시오.이 약을 복용하기: Nursing infants under 3 months of age must not take this medicine. Before taking this medicine, nursing infants aged 3 months and over but under 1 year in unavoidable cases, and pregnant women or women who may be pregnant, should consult a doctor or pharmacist. If there is no improvement in symptoms after taking it for about 2 weeks, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. When giving it to a child, administer it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian.
entries.만 7세 이상 및 성인은 1일 2회, 1회 1번씩 양쪽 비강(코안)에 분: Those aged 7 years and over and adults spray it once into each nostril (inside the nose) at a time, twice a day. Leave an interval of at least 8 hours between each use.
entries.만 7세 이하의 어린이는 이 약을 복용하지 마십시오.이 약을 복용하기 전: Children aged 7 years or under must not take this medicine. Before taking this medicine, patients with renal disorder and pregnant women or women who may be pregnant should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. When giving it to a child, administer it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. If there is no improvement in symptoms after about 2 weeks of administration, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.만 8세 이상 어린이 및 성인은 1회 1정씩, 1일 3회 식후에 복용합니: Children aged 8 years and over and adults take 1 tablet at a time, three times a day, after meals.
entries.만성변비에는 성인은 처음 2~3일간 1일 15~30 mL를 아침식전에 복: For chronic constipation, adults take 15 to 30 mL a day before breakfast for the first 2 to 3 days, and thereafter continue with 10 to 15 mL a day. In severe cases up to 45 mL may be taken. Children (7 to 14 years) take 15 mL a day for the first 2 to 3 days and thereafter continue with 10 mL a day. Young children (1 to 6 years) take 5 to 10 mL a day, and infants (under 12 months) take 5 mL a day.
entries.매일 세잔 이상 정기적 음주자가 이 약 또는 다른 해열진통제를 복용(사용: People who regularly drink three or more glasses of alcohol a day should consult a doctor or pharmacist when taking (using) this medicine or another antipyretic analgesic. It may cause gastrointestinal bleeding. Long-term use may cause hypersensitivity; if hypersensitivity occurs, stop using it and consult a doctor.
entries.매일 세잔 이상 정기적 음주자가 이 약 또는 다른 해열진통제를 복용할 때: People who regularly drink three or more glasses of alcohol a day should consult a doctor or pharmacist when taking this medicine or another antipyretic analgesic. It may cause liver damage. Serious skin reactions such as acute generalized exanthematous pustulosis, Stevens-Johnson syndrome and toxic epidermal necrolysis (Lyell's syndrome), which can very rarely be fatal, have been reported; if a skin rash or other signs of a hypersensitivity reaction appear after taking this medicine, stop taking it immediately. Do not take more than the maximum daily dose of acetaminophen (4,000 mg). It may cause liver damage. Do not take it together with other products containing acetaminophen. This medicine contains aspartame, which is metabolized to phenylalanine in the body, so patients with phenylketonuria who need to restrict their phenylalanine intake must not take it.

entries.바르비탈계 약물, 삼환계 항우울제 및 알코올을 복용한 환자, 와파린, 리: Patients who have taken barbiturates, tricyclic antidepressants or alcohol, and those taking this medicine together with warfarin, lithium, thiazide diuretics or flucloxacillin, should consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.발열, 고름가래, 드물게 설사, 구역, 구토, 매우 드물게 퀸케부종, 발: If fever, purulent sputum, rarely diarrhea, nausea or vomiting, or very rarely Quincke's edema, redness, itching, urticaria or difficulty breathing occur, stop taking this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.발진 및 발적, 부종, 자극감, 가려움 등이 나타나는 경우 이 약의 사용: If rash and redness, swelling, an irritating sensation or itching occur, stop using this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. This medicine contains benzalkonium chloride and may cause bronchospasm.
entries.발진 및 충혈되어 붉어지는 발적, 부종, 자극감, 가려움 등이 나타나는: If rash and redness in which the skin becomes congested and red, swelling, an irritating sensation or itching occur, stop using this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. This medicine contains benzalkonium chloride and may cause bronchospasm.
entries.발진, 발적(충혈되어 붉어짐), 가려움, 피부병 등이 나타나는 경우 사용: If rash, redness (congested and reddened skin), itching or skin disease occur, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.발진, 발적, 가려움, 구역, 구토, 식욕부진, 변비, 부종, 배뇨곤란,: If rash, redness, itching, nausea, vomiting, loss of appetite, constipation, edema, difficulty urinating, thirst (persistent or severe), dizziness, anxiety, tremor, insomnia, shock symptoms (urticaria, edema and chest tightness immediately after taking the medicine, together with pallor, cold hands and feet, cold sweat and difficulty breathing), Stevens-Johnson syndrome, toxic epidermal necrolysis (severe symptoms accompanied by high fever, with rash and redness and blistering like a burn appearing on the skin all over the body and on the mucous membranes of the mouth or eyes), acute generalized exanthematous pustulosis, asthma, generalized listlessness, jaundice, interstitial pneumonia (accompanied by coughing, breathlessness, difficulty breathing and fever), or ischemic colitis (sudden abdominal pain, rectal bleeding) occur, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.

entries.붉은반점, 설사, 심장박동정지, 중추신경계 기능저하 등이 나타나는 경우: If red patches, diarrhea, cardiac arrest or depressed central nervous system function occur, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.생후 1개월 미만의 소아는 이 약을 사용하지 마십시오.이 약을 사용하기: Do not use this medicine on children under 1 month of age. Before using this medicine, patients with an allergic constitution, patients hypersensitive to medicines or cosmetics, patients with severe wetness (dampness) or inflammation, and infants and young children under 6 years of age should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. When giving it to a child, administer it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. Use this medicine externally only; do not take it internally. Take care that it does not get into the eyes, and if it does, rinse it out immediately with water.
entries.생후 6개월 이상의 소아는 1회 0.4~0.6 mL/kg(5~7 mg/k: Children aged 6 months and over take 0.4 to 0.6 mL/kg (5 to 7 mg/kg) at a time as needed, at intervals of 4 to 6 hours, not exceeding a maximum of 4 times a day (28 mg/kg). For children weighing 30 kg or less, do not exceed a maximum of 25 mL (300 mg) a day. If the body weight is known it is more appropriate to give the dose based on body weight, so refer to the approved labelling for the recommended doses by age group.
entries.성인 및 12세 이상 어린이는 매 4시간 이상의 간격으로 각 비공(콧구멍: Adults and children aged 12 years and over instill 2 to 3 drops into each nostril at intervals of at least 4 hours.
entries.성인 및 5세 이상의 소아는 6-8시간마다 1방울을 점안합니다.1일 4회: Adults and children aged 5 years and over instill 1 drop every 6-8 hours. Do not use it more than 4 times a day.
entries.성인 및 만 15세 이상은 도포하는 경우 1일 3회의 범위 내에서 환부에: Adults and those aged 15 years and over, when applying it externally, apply it directly to the affected area within a limit of three times a day. When instilling it, insert and instill 2 g at a time into the rectum, within a limit of three times a day; for rectal application, fit the applicator onto the tube and insert it into the rectum.
entries.성인, 12세 이상 어린이 및 청소년은 이 약 1개를 입안에서 서서히 녹: Adults and children and adolescents aged 12 years and over take 1 piece of this medicine, letting it dissolve slowly in the mouth. Move it around in the mouth while taking it in order to avoid local irritation. If necessary, take up to a maximum of 5 a day at intervals of 3 to 6 hours, and use it for a maximum of 3 days.
entries.성인은 1일 3회까지 환부에 직접 바릅니다.12세 이하의 소아는 의사와: Adults apply it directly to the affected area up to three times a day. Children aged 12 years or under should consult a doctor.
entries.성인은 1회 1정(100 mg)씩 1일 3회 복용합니다.연령, 증상에 따: Adults take 1 tablet (100 mg) at a time, three times a day. The dose may be increased or decreased as appropriate according to age and symptoms.
entries.성인은 1회 1캡슐(300 mg)을 1일 2~3회 복용합니다.급성 호흡기: Adults take 1 capsule (300 mg) at a time, 2 to 3 times a day. When taken for acute respiratory disease, do not take it continuously for more than 10 days.
entries.성인은 1회 1포(1회 용량)씩, 1일 3회 식전 또는 식간에 복용합니다: Adults take 1 sachet (one dose) at a time, three times a day, before meals or between meals.
entries.성인은 1회 2정씩, 1일 2~3회 복용합니다.1일 2회 이상 복용시에는: Adults take 2 tablets at a time, 2 to 3 times a day. When taking it 2 or more times a day, leave an interval of at least 4 hours between doses.
entries.성인은 통증으로 인해 잠을 자기 어려운 경우 1회 1~2캡슐씩, 1일 1: When pain makes it difficult to sleep, adults take 1 to 2 capsules at a time, once a day before bedtime. entries.이 약은 육체피로, 임신 및 수유기, 병을 앓는 동안이나 회복 후의 체력: This medicine is used to supply vitamins B1, B2 and B6 in cases of physical fatigue, pregnancy and lactation, and reduced physical strength during or after an illness, and to relieve symptoms such as angular cheilitis, cheilitis, stomatitis, glossitis, eczema and dermatitis.

entries.이 약은 치열ㆍ치핵의 아픔ㆍ가려움ㆍ부종(부기)ㆍ출혈의 일시적 완화 및 소: This medicine is used for the temporary relief of pain, itching, swelling and bleeding from anal fissures and hemorrhoids, and for disinfection.

entries.이 약은 피부사상균에 의한 피부진균감염증(무좀, 완선(사타구니 백선),: This medicine is used for fungal skin infections caused by dermatophytes (athlete's foot, tinea cruris (jock itch), tinea).
entries.이 약을 복용하기 전에 고혈압, 심장애 또는 신장애, 부종 환자, 고령자: Before taking this medicine, patients with high blood pressure, cardiac disorder or renal disorder, patients with edema, the elderly, patients with a markedly weak stomach, patients with symptoms of loss of appetite, nausea or vomiting, and children should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. If there is no improvement in symptoms after taking it for several days, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.이 약을 복용하기 전에 임부 또는 임신하고 있을 가능성이 있는 여성 및: Before taking this medicine, pregnant women or women who may be pregnant and breastfeeding women, patients with mild to moderate liver disorder, and patients hypersensitive to Yellow No. 5 or those who have experienced it should consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.이 약을 복용하는 동안 다른 진해거담제, 감기약, 항히스타민제를 함유하는: While taking this medicine, do not take other antitussive-expectorants, cold medicines or oral medicines containing antihistamines. People who are taking MAO inhibitors used in the treatment of depression or Parkinson's disease, or who are within 2 weeks of stopping them, must not take this medicine. Do not drink alcohol while taking it.
entries.이 약을 복용하는 동안 아스피린, 다른 비스테로이드성 소염진통제, 고용량: While taking this medicine, do not take aspirin, other non-steroidal anti-inflammatory analgesics or high-dose methotrexate. Before taking this medicine, patients receiving corticosteroids, alcohol, digoxin, phenytoin, probenecid, sulfinpyrazone, sulfonylureas, ACE inhibitors or angiotensin II receptor antagonists, diuretics, lithium, coumarin anticoagulants (warfarin, etc.), baclofen, immunosuppressants (cyclosporine, tacrolimus, sirolimus), thrombolytics, ticlopidine, antithrombotic agents, medicines that increase the blood potassium level (potassium-sparing diuretics, ACE inhibitors, angiotensin II receptor antagonists, immunosuppressants such as cyclosporine and tacrolimus, trimethoprim, heparin, etc.), inducers of CYP2C8 or CYP2C9 (rifampicin, phenobarbital), low-dose methotrexate (less than 15 mg per week), antiplatelet agents or selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors should consult a doctor or pharmacist.
While taking this medicine, do not take antipsychotics or sleeping pills.
entries.이 약을 사용하기 전에 발진, 발적, 가려움증 등 약이나 화장품 등에 의: Before using this medicine, those who have experienced allergic symptoms such as rash, redness or itching from medicines or cosmetics, and patients with severe dampness or erosion, should consult a doctor or pharmacist. If the symptoms do not improve after 5 to 6 days of use, stop using this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Use this medicine only as a medicine applied to the lips, in accordance with its indications and method of use. Take care that it does not get into the eyes. If it does get into the eyes, rinse them immediately with water or lukewarm water. If the symptoms are severe, see an ophthalmologist. Children should use it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian.
entries.이 약을 사용하기 전에 혈압강하제, 항우울약을 복용 중인 환자는 의사 또: Before using this medicine, patients who are taking antihypertensives or antidepressants should consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.이상 증상, 설사, 구역, 구토, 알레르기 반응이 나타나는 경우 복용을: If abnormal symptoms, diarrhea, nausea, vomiting or an allergic reaction occur, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.인산염, 칼슘염, 경구(먹는, 복용하는)용 테트라사이클린계 제제, 제산제: Do not take this medicine together with phosphates, calcium salts, oral tetracycline preparations, antacids or levodopa. If taken together with oral contraceptives containing estrogen, antialdosterone agents or triamterene, consult a doctor or pharmacist. Avoid teas containing tannin, such as green tea and black tea, while taking it and before and after taking it.

If taken together with antialdosterone agents or triamterene, consult a doctor or pharmacist. entries.임부 또는 임신하고 있을 가능성이 있는 여성, 수유부, 갈락토오스 불내성: Pregnant women or women who may be pregnant, breastfeeding women, and patients with hereditary problems such as galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency or glucose-galactose malabsorption must not take this medicine. Before taking this medicine, patients with high blood pressure, cardiac disorder or renal disorder, patients with edema, the elderly, patients with symptoms of diarrhea, loose stools, loss of appetite, nausea or vomiting, patients with a weak stomach, those in a weakened state after illness, patients whose physical strength is markedly weakened, patients who sweat profusely, patients with circulatory disorders such as angina pectoris or myocardial infarction, patients with urinary difficulty or hyperthyroidism, patients who have developed rash, redness or itching from this medicine, and patients with diabetes should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. If there is no improvement in symptoms after taking it for about 1 month, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.전염성 농가진, 모낭염, 칸디다증, 백선, 모낭염, 부스럼, 피부자극,: If impetigo contagiosa, folliculitis, candidiasis, tinea, folliculitis, boils, skin irritation, stinging pain (a pricking pain), fever, a burning sensation, rash, redness (congested and reddened skin), flushing, itching, dry skin, pustular dermatitis, allergic contact dermatitis, prickly heat, worsening of a wound, pressure sores, pustulosis, a rise in intraocular pressure when used on the eyelid skin, glaucoma (blurred vision, impaired eyesight), or very rarely local hypersensitivity occur, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Systemic absorption may cause reversible suppression of the hypothalamic-pituitary-adrenal axis, Cushing's syndrome, hyperglycemia, diabetes and impaired eyesight, and blurred vision of unknown frequency.
entries.제산제 복용 또는 우유 섭취 후 1시간 이내에는 이 약을 복용하지 마십시: Do not take this medicine within 1 hour of taking an antacid or drinking milk.
entries.중등도의 일시적인 따끔따끔한 느낌, 드물게 접촉성알레르기가 나타날 수 있: A moderate, temporary stinging sensation may occur, and rarely contact allergy may occur.
entries.진해(기침을 그치게 함)거담제(가래약), 다른 감기약, 해열진통제, 진정: Do not take this medicine together with antitussives (which stop coughing) and expectorants (phlegm medicines), other cold medicines, antipyretic analgesics, sedatives, or oral medicines containing antihistamines (oral preparations for rhinitis (nasal inflammation), motion sickness medicines, anti-allergy medicines). entries.출혈성뇌졸중, 구역·구토, 지속적이거나 심한 목마름, 변비, 식욕부진,: If hemorrhagic stroke, nausea and vomiting, persistent or severe thirst, constipation, loss of appetite, rash and redness, itching, difficulty urinating, headache, facial flushing, abnormal sensitivity to light, or urticaria, edema, chest tightness, pallor, cold hands and feet, cold sweat and difficulty breathing immediately after taking the medicine occur, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.칼시트리올 또는 다른 비타민 D 제제와 함께 복용하지 마십시오.강심배당체: Do not take this medicine together with calcitriol or other vitamin D preparations. If taken together with cardiac glycosides, barbiturates, phenytoin, rifampicin, bisphosphonates, sodium fluoride, estramustine, iron preparations, zinc preparations, oral tetracyclines, quinolone antibiotics, L-thyroxine, cholestyramine, orlistat, laxatives such as paraffin, corticosteroids, thiazide diuretics or loop diuretics (furosemide, torasemide), consult a doctor or pharmacist. entries.통증, 시야변화, 지속적인 충혈이나 자극감을 경험하는 경우 이 약의 사용: If you experience pain, changes in your field of vision, or persistent redness or irritation, stop using this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
If used together with propylene glycol, consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.피부의 세균성(전염성 농가진, 모낭염 등), 바이러스성 감염증, 모낭염,: If bacterial skin infections (impetigo contagiosa, folliculitis, etc.), viral infections, folliculitis, boils, skin irritation, stinging pain, fever, a burning sensation, itching, rash and redness, flushing, dry skin, pustular dermatitis, prickly heat, worsening of a wound, pressure sores, pustulosis, hypersensitivity, skin discoloration, hypertrichosis, acneiform eruption, hypopigmentation, perioral dermatitis, allergic contact dermatitis, skin erosion, secondary infection, skin atrophy, striae, suppression of pituitary-adrenocortical function, a rise in intraocular pressure, glaucoma, blurred vision of unknown frequency, renal disorder or hearing loss occur, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.필요 시 각각의 눈에 1회 1방울씩, 1일 수회 눈에 넣으십시오.눈에는: When necessary, instill 1 drop into each eye at a time, several times a day. To instill it, gently pull the lower eyelid down and, while looking upwards, place one drop in the lower conjunctival sac.
entries.항응고제(쿠마린, 아스피린, 디피리다몰, 덱스트란, 스트렙토키나제)와 함: Do not use this medicine together with anticoagulants (coumarin, aspirin, dipyridamole, dextran, streptokinase).
entries.혈압강하제, 알코올, 중추신경억제제(수면제, 진정제, 안정제), MAO: Do not take this medicine together with antihypertensives, alcohol, central nervous system depressants (sleeping pills, sedatives, tranquilizers), MAO inhibitors, sympathomimetics, tricyclic antidepressants, guanethidine, bretylium, bethanidine, debrisoquine, methyldopa, sympathomimetic drugs (decongestants, appetite suppressants, amphetamine-type stimulants) or adrenergic blocking agents (inhibitors).
